messages.author: 6a75f6f91a59c568
messages.subject: Can I convert boot.mirt() and PLCI.mirt() to mod2values() form?
parts:
Hi, Phil.

Can I convert boot.mirt() and PLCI.mirt() to mod2values() form?

Sometimes, I have some difficulties in estimating standard errors, so I want to use boot.mirt() or PLCI.mirt() for using in 'pars' argument.

So, I want to convert boot.mirt() and PLCI.mirt() to mod2values() form. It's possible?

-
Seongho

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Can I convert boot.mirt() and PLCI.mirt() to mod2values() form?
parts:
I'm confused on what you're asking. mod2values() doesn't contain any information about standard errors, even when models are estimated with the standard large-sample AVOC methods.

Phil
